name: Postiz
description:
Postiz is a social media scheduling tool.
With the Postiz connector, Claude can manage your publishing workflow end-to-end: - List your connected channels (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest, Discord, Slack, Telegram, and more)
- Draft posts and schedule them
- Give you analytics of your socials

_published_faq.name: How do I add Postiz to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Postiz to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.postiz.com/mcp-oauth-claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Postiz MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Postiz provides these MCP tools: groupList, integrationList, integrationSchedulePostTool, integrationSchema, postSettingsTool, postsListTool, triggerTool, and uploadFromUrlTool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Postiz?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Postiz in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Postiz requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Postiz is developed by Postiz. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
